goal: Turn the Monetizing Athletic Progression deck into an implementable tier spec: the recommended features per tier (Basic, Standard, Premium) and the mandatory Coach-to-Player connections the platform must establish
constraints: Write only player-tiers-spec.md (process-designer) and research.md (research); edit no other file
Feature matrix table header is exactly: | Feature | Deck ref | Basic | Standard | Premium |
Connections table header is exactly: | ID | Connection | Direction | Data | Trigger | Tiers | Safeguard |
No pay-to-win: no tier may let money buy XP, Coach Coins, attribute points or badges (deck S8)
Players are minors: every connection names its safeguard (consent, visibility, no private 1:1 adult-minor channel)
Recommendations beyond the deck are marked as such and cite research.md

done_when.criterion: Every feature the deck names appears as a matrix row citing its slide
The matrix has >= 15 rows with a value for all three tiers, and each tier has its own section
>= 6 mandatory Coach-Player connections, each with id, direction, data, trigger, tiers and safeguard
Every link in the spec resolves

The deck's guardrails become enforceable rules, the deck's inconsistencies (price, decoy vs discount, missing coach actor) are resolved with a recommendation, and the connections are justified by tier features that depend on them
